newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Reading & Bates estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Reading & Bates estimate cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw has cut its 1997 earnings per share forecast for offshore drilling company Reading & Bates Corp to $1.90 from $2.00, and has cut its 1998 forecast to $2.45 from $2.55.

-- Analyst Iain Smith, in a research note, cited higher operating expenses for the Jake Bates and other selected rigs, higher operating costs from Reading & Bates Development Co, and higher than expected interest expense.

-- "Notwithstanding that we have lowered our 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates, Reading & Bates remains one of the most attractive stocks in the offshore drilling segment from a valuation perspective," Smith said.
-- He reiterated his buy rating on the stock, which was down 3/8 at 26-1/4 in late-morning trade.
